methods.name: Exact BRC Newton recursion over rational valuation scales and selected-root evaluation coefficients
capabilities: represent multiplicative Newton scales by finite rational prime valuations and compare them exactly
perform rational-root Newton rescaling on finite rational characteristic jets
represent algebraic selected-root coefficients as rational-polynomial evaluations without floating roots
decide selected-root semantic zero equality sign and rational contact orders exactly
continue algebraic-base Newton recursion through later rational translated roots
typed_inputs: rational selected translated roots for recursive continuation
methods.core_law: Finite Newton jets remain exact under rational selected translated roots when scales are stored in Q_{>0}^x tensor_Z Q; an irrational algebraic base root can be carried by selected-root evaluation coefficients while subsequent translated roots remain rational.
methods.hard_boundary: No generic algebraic-number field, general inversion, irrational translated-root continuation, complete Puiseux solver, floating radical/eigensolver, signed/amplitude, or infinite-state semantics are promoted.
